title: ListServices discovery analogue
purpose: Retain discovery-command diversity with a minimal valid ListServices request that cleanly exercises a distinct parser entry point.
expected_behavior: A compliant target should parse the encapsulation header and return or internally process a ListServices response path.
constraints_preserved: Length is zero with no command-specific data.
The full 24-byte encapsulation header is present.
Session handle is zero as appropriate for discovery style commands.
issue_safety_notes: This keeps only the structurally valid discovery surface and avoids any oversized UDP-style issue payload analogue.
